div.span: every project starts with a folder and a dream
my home lab has more uptime than most startups
i test things. sometimes before shipping.
my OBS setup is production-ready. i don't stream.
home lab is getting out of hand. good.
my dad wanted to control the hot tub on his phone. so i built it.
i automate things i could just do manually. it's a gift.
i like projects with sharp edges
it started as a keychain. it now has a docker backend.
i just wanted to check the bus times
i have custom OBS overlays for coding, electronics, and gaming
the hot tub still works btw
i spent hours on OBS overlays i never go live with
i think about edge cases in the shower
debugging is just detective work with worse coffee
works on my machine. also works on the server. rare.
building an open-source robot arm. currently in pieces.
i have too many open tabs and half-finished PCBs
scope creep is a feature
deleted more code than i wrote today. productive.
my media server notifies me via webhook. i built the webhook handler.
one button on my stream deck deploys crewvolution to prod
i built a dev dashboard because i didn't like my other dev dashboards
i like when things work reliably. so i make them work reliably.
i name my variables well. at least i think so.
i write firmware. also the backend. also the frontend.
powered by curiosity and too much coffee and energy drinks
the PCB is fine. probably.
closed laptop. opened it again. just one more thing.
yes it has a web portal. no i don't know why.
i once debugged a wake stub at 2am. would do it again.
i have different OBS scenes for coding, electronics, and gaming. i dont stream.
i make things blink. then i make them talk to a server.
i have a poker game running in docker. don't ask why.
e-ink, deep sleep, wake stubs - this is my happy place
